description: I'm passionate about technology, innovation, and building solutions to real-world problems. Through COSMICPULSE, I aim to contribute to advancing astronaut health monitoring and wellbeing. I'm looking to collaborate with creative, committed individuals with skills in AI/ML, software development, biomedical engineering, data science, UI/UX design, and hardware engineering who are eager to build something impactful together.
summary:
CosmicPulse is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring and intelligence platform designed to support human wellbeing during space exploration. It brings together vital signs, activity, sleep and recovery data to help users monitor health trends, understand changes from their personal baselines and receive AI-assisted insights and recommendations. The platform combines interactive visual dashboards with voice-based AI assistance, spoken feedback and haptic notifications to make health information more accessible, including for users with visual impairments.

CosmicPulse addresses the challenge of monitoring human health in demanding space environments, where distance from Earth and limited access to immediate medical support make continuous health awareness especially important. Rather than simply displaying health readings, it aims to make health information easier to understand and communicate, helping users recognise patterns that may require attention. Although designed with astronauts in mind, its approach has potential applications on Earth, particularly in remote communities and other settings where accessible health monitoring can make a difference.
details:
CosmicPulse

CosmicPulse is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring platform designed to support human wellbeing during space exploration. It monitors vital signs, sleep and physical activity, presenting health trends through interactive dashboards and personalised insights.

Its AI capabilities analyse available health information, identify unusual patterns and provide understandable explanations and recommendations. Users can also interact with the AI assistant for health-related guidance.

CosmicPulse promotes accessibility through voice interaction, spoken feedback, screen-reader support and haptic notifications, making health information easier to access beyond traditional visual dashboards.

Technologies Used: Figma for UI/UX design, Next.js for frontend development, Node.js for backend development, an inbuilt AI model for health-data analysis, and Claude AI for intelligent assistance.

Benefits and Impact: The platform aims to improve health awareness, support early recognition of unusual health patterns and make health information more accessible. Although designed for astronauts, its approach has potential applications for people on Earth, particularly in remote communities.

Creativity and Innovation: CosmicPulse combines AI-powered health intelligence, personalised monitoring, interactive visualisation and multimodal accessibility in one platform.

Factors Considered: Our team considered the challenges of spaceflight, data reliability, accessibility, privacy, usability and the importance of responsible AI recommendations that complement rather than replace professional medical care.
